name: Image to Video
original_description:
Pick an image from your MegaScenes library, an upload or one made here, describe how it should move, and get a short video clip.

ChatGPT lists your recent images, tells you what the run needs and animates the one you choose when you ask: a slow zoom, a camera pan, wind in the hair, waves rolling in. The clip plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For bringing product shots, portraits and illustrations to life.

Limitations: it starts from images in your MegaScenes library; pictures attached in the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
